prompt: Which of these best reflects what "Designing for Keyboard-Only Navigation" covers?
hints: Reread the first point of the lesson: "Every interactive element needs a visible focus state and a logical tab order — a design where tabbing jumps unpredictably around the page is unusable for keyboard-only users"
explanation: Every interactive element needs a visible focus state and a logical tab order — a design where tabbing jumps unpredictably around the page is unusable for keyboard-only users — that's the core idea this lesson builds from.

prompt: True or false: Custom interactive components (a custom dropdown, a modal) need the same keyboard support as their native HTML equivalents — this often gets lost when designers and engineers build custom components without considering keyboard behavior
